Name: Pokemon Otters
Author: JollyAxolotl
Description:
Currently includes Buizel, Floatzel, Oshawott, Dewott, and their shiny equivalents.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/212901518-1717703844.png[/img]

The Pokemon otters come to Stardew Valley! These feisty otters will catch you their respective fish (fresh-water: Buizel/Floatzel, salt-water: Oshawott/Dewott) and may even bring you back a Pokemon fish (requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16642]Pokemon Fish[/url] to be installed). On rare occasions, they are said to bring treasures to those they consider worthy.

All Buizel and Floatzel will start as Buizel, but not all will become Floatzel as an adult (Oshawott and Dewott are the same). You will know its final form when purchasing from Marnie from the description at the top when choosing a barn. Shinies are denoted by a star in their name and have a 1 in 10 chance of occurring.

Pokemon otters can live in the vanilla barn or the Pokemon Barn added by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24619]Pokemon Ranch[/url] mod. This can be set in the configuration settings.
Note: These configuration settings will not do anything if the mod is not installed.

Warning: If your Pokemon otters are performing miracles and walking on water instead of swimming, check to see if you have the mod Alternative Textures installed. There's an odd [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246?tab=bugs&BH=1]bug[/url] in that mod that prevents animals from using their swimming animations.
